script_text: Stop everything, Gemini, because Jupiter in your first house is amplifying your natural Air element and confidence this week. Mon through Wed, your ruling planet Mercury trines expansive Jupiter while the Libra Sun energizes your Seventh House, making every negotiation effortless, charming, and profitable. By Thursday, Mercury enters Scorpio, squaring your Fourth House Mars, and clouding every digital communication you send. This is the key turning point: pause before replying to any work email. By weekend, Venus in your Tenth House trines Saturn in your Sixth, stabilizing your income and unlocking a long-term career path. In love, a past flame surfaces via mutual friends on Friday, but keep boundaries clear until trust rebuilds. Best day is Wednesday for bold communication. Worst day is Thursday due to severe mental fog. Stay grounded, protect your inner peace, and schedule all meetings before noon. Follow for daily updates.
